verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes incident.io exposing its own data via a hosted MCP *server* so external AI assistants can query it (docs-10/29/40/47, probe-3, probe-rt-1) — this is the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether incident.io itself can plug in and use tools from external MCP servers. No evidence shows incident.io's AI features (e.g. Investigations) acting as an MCP client consuming third-party MCP servers' tools.
